company.name: Cycloramic
company.one_liner: An app that makes your iPhone spin on its own to take 360° photos.

facts.summary: Cycloramic uses the phone's vibration to make an iPhone rotate by itself on a table and capture a full panorama.
highlights: The app has been downloaded millions of times.
It only works with the shape of certain iPhones.
It earns very little money so far.
The founder is a strong engineer with more app ideas.

real_deal.summary: Mark Cuban and Lori Greiner invested $500,000 for 15%.

outcome.headline: The original app faded, but the team pivoted and sold to Carvana for about $22M.
outcome.story: New iPhone designs stopped the spinning trick from working. The founder pivoted to 360° photos for car dealers (Car360), and Carvana bought the company for about $22 million.
